gbm_population_evidence.quote: Patients with known enhancing CNS lesions, including but not limited to gliomas, meningiomas, glioblastomas, schwannomas, brain metastases, multiple sclerosis lesions, that are on an ongoing follow-up MRI schedule

candidate_evidence.quote: [DRUG] RVP-001 (other names: Mn-PyC3A, mangaverate): MRI contrast agent

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Subjects may include individuals who have a stable primary brain tumor, metastatic brain tumors, multiple sclerosis, or other gadolinium-enhancing CNS lesions.

role_evidence.quote: [DRUG] RVP-001 (other names: Mn-PyC3A, mangaverate): MRI contrast agent
The ultimate goal of this research program is development of a gadolinium-free alternative to current general purpose MRI contrast agents.
Subjects will have known gadolinium-enhancing CNS lesions and will have a gadolinium-based contrast agent-enhanced MRI of the brain 2-14 days before receiving RVP-001 with imaging.

agents.drug_class_hint: gadolinium MRI contrast agent, unspecified product (reference imaging)

coder_notes: Diagnostic MRI contrast agent trial in mixed CNS lesions (tumours and multiple sclerosis); glioblastomas named in inclusion criteria, so basket_gbm_eligible, but there is no therapeutic candidate. Moiety taken from the record's other name 'mangaverate'. GBCA is not a registered intervention but every subject has a study GBCA-enhanced MRI used as comparator; listed as diagnostic for transparency (adjudicator may drop under R9). Three ascending-dose experimental arms, no control arm. 'Pharmacodynamics' in the description refers to imaging enhancement by a contrast agent, not antitumour target engagement.
